defaults.video_script: When Cristiano Ronaldo signed for Manchester United in two thousand three, fans and pundits mocked him as all tricks and no goals. He went seven appearances without scoring. Then, with a trademark free kick against Portsmouth, he found the net for the very first time in a United shirt. Ferguson turned to his coaching staff and said, remember this name. Eighteen years later, Ronaldo had scored over seven hundred career goals.
